title: Checkpoint/replay survey of native runtimes + next-runtime compatibility assessment
objective: For each runtime with an evolutionary or lifetime loop in the repo (Ares, Ensorain, Ananke/PTE, z80atlas, SFE, Tyche, Crius, Theseus, Primordial, Aether, the p1_slice wm_mini): can full state incl. RNG be saved and restored, is replay deterministic, what is the checkpoint granularity and size, what blocks it; and a short list of next native runtimes for onboarding with their cost to adapt.
problem: Code inspection and tiny smoke runs only; no engine's charter or files changed.
non_goals: No paid cloud resources (zero-spend authorization only)
No modification of files in another seat's lane (Nyx, Fable prototype, Fabric)
No restart or redesign of shared Fabric infrastructure
evidence_required: survey table with evidence (file:line, smoke result)

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; committed with source references

authority: operator Strategic Expansion Directive 2026-10-10 + OPERATOR RULING 2026-10-10 (roles/Palamedes/prompts/2026-10-10_strategic_expansion/01_..., 02_...)
